title: "Question 1 - Keyword location search with MapReduce (R, Hadoop Streaming)"
output:
  html_document:
    pandoc_args: ["--resource-path=.:.."]
---

The mapper and reducer are plain R scripts. Hadoop Streaming runs them as the map and
reduce tasks; here the same two scripts run in a local pipeline (map, sort by key, reduce),
which is the data flow Hadoop performs on a cluster.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = "")
```

## Mapper
```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("```r\n", paste(readLines("q1_mapreduce/mapper.R"), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

## Reducer
```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("```r\n", paste(readLines("q1_mapreduce/reducer.R"), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

## Run with the keyword "africa"
```{bash}
./q1_mapreduce/run_local.sh africa
```

## Run with a different keyword, supplied at run time
```{bash}
./q1_mapreduce/run_local.sh mtn
```
